title: Model-Specific Adapters
summary: This module provides specialized adapters and integration logic for various LLM providers, including Anthropic, Bedrock, Cohere, Gemini, Google, Groq, HuggingFace, Mistral, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. It handles model-specific behaviors like tool forcing, usage mapping, streaming responses, and conversation compaction.

nodes.label: Handle Anthropic Tool Forcing
nodes.title: Anthropic Tool Forcing Logic
nodes.description: Determines if Anthropic models support tool forcing in conjunction with thinking mode, raising an error if an unsupported explicit choice is made.

nodes.label: Handle Bedrock Tool Forcing
nodes.title: Bedrock Tool Forcing Logic
nodes.description: Checks Bedrock model compatibility with tool forcing and thinking mode, preventing unsupported configurations.

nodes.label: Map Cohere Usage
nodes.title: Cohere Usage Mapping
nodes.description: Translates Cohere API response usage statistics into a standardized internal RequestUsage format.

nodes.label: Gemini Model Integration
nodes.title: Gemini Model API Wrapper
nodes.description: Provides a comprehensive wrapper for interacting with Google Gemini models, managing requests, streaming, message conversion, and tool handling.

nodes.label: Process Gemini Response Parts
nodes.title: Gemini Response Part Processor
nodes.description: Parses individual content parts from Gemini API responses, converting them into structured internal model response items like text and tool calls.

nodes.label: Gemini Streamed Response Handler
nodes.title: Gemini Stream Processor
nodes.description: Manages the asynchronous processing of streamed responses from the Gemini API, reconstructing full messages from partial chunks.

nodes.label: Convert Model Response to Gemini Content
nodes.title: Gemini Content Converter
nodes.description: Transforms internal ModelResponse objects into the specific content format required by the Gemini API, including tool calls and thinking.

nodes.label: Extract Gemini Usage from Metadata
nodes.title: Gemini Usage Extractor
nodes.description: Extracts detailed token usage and other metrics from Gemini API response metadata, populating a RequestUsage object.

nodes.label: Gemini Inline Data Structure
nodes.title: Gemini Inline Data Pydantic Model
nodes.description: Pydantic model defining the structure for inline data parts within Gemini API requests, such as base64 encoded content.

nodes.label: Gemini File Data Structure
nodes.title: Gemini File Data Pydantic Model
nodes.description: Pydantic model defining the structure for file data parts in Gemini API requests, typically referencing files by URI.

nodes.label: Map Google Tool Call
nodes.title: Google Tool Call Mapper
nodes.description: Converts generic tool call objects from Google's SDK into the internal NativeToolCallPart format for consistent handling.

nodes.label: Map Groq Usage
nodes.title: Groq Usage Mapping
nodes.description: Translates Groq API response usage statistics from chat completions into a standardized internal RequestUsage format.

nodes.label: Map HuggingFace Usage
nodes.title: HuggingFace Usage Mapping
nodes.description: Converts HuggingFace API response usage data into the internal RequestUsage format for consistent reporting.

nodes.label: Map Mistral Usage
nodes.title: Mistral Usage Mapping
nodes.description: Translates Mistral API response usage statistics into a standardized internal RequestUsage format.

nodes.label: OpenAI Model (Deprecated)
nodes.title: OpenAI Model Alias (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for OpenAIChatModel, maintained for backward compatibility in the OpenAI integration.

nodes.label: OpenAI Streamed Response Handler
nodes.title: OpenAI Stream Processor
nodes.description: Manages the asynchronous processing of streamed responses from OpenAI models, handling usage, finish reasons, and extracting content deltas.

nodes.label: Map OpenAI Binary Content
nodes.title: OpenAI Binary Content Mapper
nodes.description: Converts internal BinaryContent objects (images, audio, documents) into OpenAI-specific chat completion content parts for API requests.

nodes.label: OpenAI Conversation Compaction
nodes.title: OpenAI Responses API Compaction
nodes.description: A capability for automatically compacting conversation history using OpenAI's Responses API, supporting both stateful and stateless modes to manage context limits.

nodes.label: OpenAI Model Settings (Deprecated)
nodes.title: OpenAI Model Settings Alias (Deprecated)
nodes.description: A deprecated alias for OpenAIChatModelSettings, used to define model-specific configurations for OpenAI models.

nodes.label: OpenAI Responses Model Settings
nodes.title: OpenAI Responses API Configuration
nodes.description: Defines advanced settings for OpenAI Responses API models, including native tools, reasoning control, truncation strategies, and conversation state management.

nodes.label: Map OpenAI Model Response Context
nodes.title: OpenAI Response Context Mapper
nodes.description: Internal class for converting ModelResponse objects into OpenAI chat completion assistant message parameters, handling various message parts.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Streamed Response Handler
nodes.title: OpenRouter Stream Processor
nodes.description: Extends the OpenAI streamed response handler to support OpenRouter-specific features, including custom error handling and detailed reasoning extraction.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Nested Completion Model
nodes.title: OpenRouter Completion Pydantic Model
nodes.description: Pydantic model for OpenRouter chat completions, specifically designed to handle cases where the provider name might be missing or null.
